ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
ex.zh: 我買了幾顆蛋和一點牛奶。

ex.en: An egg should cook for at least 5 minutes.
I can't eat raw eggs; they must be cooked.
ex.zh: 我不能吃生蛋，一定要煮熟。

ex.en: Losing the game in front of his friends really hurt his ego.
ex.zh: 在朋友面前輸了比賽，讓他的自尊心很受傷。

ex.en: His big ego makes it hard for him to admit mistakes.
ex.zh: 他太自負了，很難承認自己的錯誤。
